alex: Quick one-liner game — describe your current brain state in one word + one emoji. I'll go first: defragging 🧠

maria: Overloaded 😅

sam: caffeinated ☕️

jen: spreadsheet-y 🗂️

kevin: incubating 🥚

alex: Love 'incubating' — feels optimistic :laughing:

maria: Also quick question: should we get a waffle iron for the kitchen? yes/no

pm-bot: Poll created: 'Waffle iron for kitchen' — options: Yes / No. Voting open for 24h

sam: Yes — waffles = morale :thumbsup:

jen: yes. Belgian waffle vibes. I'll bring a spatula.

kevin: No — imagine the crumbs and sticky control. Microwave will be sad.

maria: I'll ping procurement if more than 3 people vote yes. anyone want to chip in $5? @alex @jen

alex: in for $5. also PSA: don't put foil in the toaster oven again, lab 3 still smells like yesterday's experiment.

jen: noted. also I'll bring maple syrup if this passes :maple_leaf:

sam: maple syrup + espresso = productivity booster. also 'defragging' is a mood.

alex: Alright, thread conclusion: waffles & syrup if the poll wins. otherwise, more one-liners next week. Signing off to actually defrag. 😴
